title.en: Authorizing the National Development Company to Assist Local Shipbuilders and Persons and Entities Engaged in Interisland Shipping and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en:
Any provision of law, decree, order or regulation to the contrary notwithstanding, there is hereby
appropriated or from loans which may be contracted locally for the purpose, the sum of Two Hundred Million
Pesos (P200M) for the National Development Company to be used for the construction, purchase, or
acquisition of interisland vessels for the purpose, or acquisition of interisland vessels for the purpose of resale,
lease, or charter to persons, associations or corporations engaged in Philippine inter-island shipping. Provided,
that, only citizens of the Philippines or associations or corporations sixty per centum (60%) of the capital of
which is owned by such citizens may be qualified under the provisions of this Decree. The fund may also be
invested in loans to such citizens, associations or corporations for the purpose of financing the construction,
purchase, or acquisition and operation by such citizens, associations or corporations of inter-island vessels.

All vessels acquired and/or financed under the provisions of this Decree shall be constructed by
local shipowners registered with the Board of Investments.

All moneys representing payments of rental, purchase price of vessels, and payments of principal
and interest of loans made pursuant to this decree shall constitute a revolving fund to be used exclusively to
carry out the provisions of this Decree, the same to be administered and disbursed by the National
Development Company.

Any law, decree, order, rule or regulation inconsistent herewith is hereby repealed or amended
accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect upon approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
